plan.notes: Source: 'Computer Science Technology Master Schedule 2-Year A.A.S.' (snead.edu, revised 8/26/2026; Fall 2026 master schedule). College's note: 'Courses should be taken during the semester listed. Courses are not offered every semester.' Terms recorded in the source's listing order (Spring 1st-year first); a student's entry term (fall or spring) rotates them through the same five blocks. Sequenced credit sum is 67 (science/math elective recorded at 3 of 3-4); the source prints 'Total Hours 64-65' — genuine discrepancy kept verbatim. Genuine catalog quirks kept verbatim: (1) the Spring 1st-year IT Admin Track Requirement row prints 3 hours with a blank course cell — modeled as a CIS XXX choice placeholder, never invented; (2) the Fall 2nd-year Core row prints 'CIS 268 CIS 268 Software Support' (duplicated code in the name column) — title recorded as 'Software Support'; (3) the Spring 1st-year Cyber Security Track Requirement row prints no hours value; CIS 260 is 3 cr per the 2026-2027 catalog course list (cross-checked in-session). Catalog year is the retrieval-year stamp per convention: the source prints a revision date (8/26/2026), not a catalog year.
